name: erd-designer
description: Visual database (ERD) designer with accounts and cloud-saved diagrams.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run build:api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
